In thunderbird, there is no email database. Each message folder retains all messages. If your accounts are POP, an easy way to save them is to do this:

  1. install the importexporttools NG addon
  2. highlight a folder to be saved, rightclick, and select importexport option to export as mbox file
  3. next, highlight Local Folders, rightclick and select importexport option to import mbox
  4. repeat the prior 2 steps for each desired folder
  5. check that the copied folders are all correct
  6. you have now saved all the messages to Local Folders and the POP account may be removed.

The only way I know to remove this item is to use a certain CSS code in a userChrome.css file in the Thunderbird profile

• in Thunderbird go to Settings > General > scroll to bottom and click "Config Editor...", search for toolkit.legacyUserProfileCustomizations.stylesheets and toggle its value from false to true • open a text editor and copy + paste the following CSS code in the editor 

#tbpro-menu-id-root {  display: none !important; }


• name the file userChrome.css , save it to your Desktop and remove the .txt suffixe your OS will add • create a folder, name it chrome and move the userChrome.css file in folder chrome • in Thunderbird go to Help >Troubleshooting Information > Profile Folder > Open Folder...., then exit Thunderbird • move the folder chrome in the profile folder and restart Thunderbird
